study: Physical face information, same observations for every encoder
contrast_inference: In addition to paired predictive contrasts, cross the directional MI bounds to form [L_A-U_B, U_A-L_B], with paired delete-packet SE for each endpoint and simultaneous outer limits. Only an outer lower limit above zero supports a positive population MI gap; a significant log-score gain alone does not. Compare discrete to all ordinary and historical rsmi on cold, and historical rsmi separately to the selected ordinary. Contrast-family size at cold counts all possible original-vs-ordinary choices (2*n_ordinary+1); on transfer there are three fixed contrasts. Bonferroni families for crossed MI limits and frozen face log-score intervals are separate. The prespecified index-4 log-score prediction itself uses its single pointwise interval.
target: At every periodic anchor, V is the 2x2x2 ordered ternary tile. Uniform J in (-z,+z,-y,+y,-x,+x) registers the physical exterior 2x2 face with normal coordinate -2/+3 and tangential coordinates 0,1: one intervening layer. Y is its ordered pattern (81 states), NOT a neighbor encoded by a competing map. Pool over anchors and average over J, never condition on position, nor treat overlaps as independent. C=(n_A,n_B) is the target face composition, 15 possibilities. H is the emitted code. Natural logs for information, base 2 only for achieved deterministic single-tile entropy H(H), not a stream compression claim.
models: Primary: discrete four-symbol finite-state optimization of the registered RSMI objective. Separate reference: rsmi, the previously learned neural RG tile code, not retrained here. Ordinary competitors: ALL archived two-bit comparators other than rsmi, plus affine, a new environmental train-optimized affine encoder. Full V is the 6561-state uncompressed reference, not a same-budget competitor. Fit on cold TRAIN only. All supervised competitors use identical observations; validation never fits an encoder or decoder.
decoder: From cold counts only, q(y|j)=(n_jy+1/2)/(n_j+81/2). q(y|j,h)=(n_jhy+k*q(y|j))/(n_jh+k); k=81 for every code INCLUDING full V (one prior face-equivalent count per possible outcome in total, allocated according to the train marginal). Occupied dense rows dominate this prior; empty or sparse full-tile rows continuously back off to the same strictly positive baseline. No empirical-Bayes strength selection. Composition q(c) is the sum of q(y) over c, and within-composition q(y|c)=q(y)/q(c), so the log score decomposes exactly. Never refit at another beta, even for the marginal.
bounds: Per physical face, target I(H;Y|J). L = validation plug-in H(Y|J) minus held-out CE of the frozen conditional. U = held-out CE of frozen q(Y|J) minus plug-in H(Y|J,H). Marginal and conditional CE exceed their population oracle entropies in expectation for fixed fits; plug-in conditional entropy is downward-biased by concavity at fixed total, even though tile samples overlap. These are directionally conservative population scores, not deterministic sample inequalities or rigorous finite-sample coverage. The plug-in MI is descriptive only. Analogous chain-rule components for I(H;C|J) and I(H;Y|C,J), with positive frozen conditional composition and arrangement decoders. Each component uses its own empirical conditional entropy, not subtraction of separately clipped bounds. All scores may be negative or wide. Cold/warm mismatch (including the frozen marginal) can widen the sandwich. Lower-score differences are frozen decoder log-score differences, NOT bounds on true MI differences.
uncertainty: 32 equal disjoint validation packets of 64 complete parents each, with every orientation and overlapping tile retained together. Pooled full sample and 32 delete-one pooled-count recalculations give jackknife SE and approximate two-sided t(31) 95% limits conditional on frozen fits and independent/exchangeable parent packets. No independent-face errors; uncertainty for train fitting, genuine new disorder/size, serial correlation across parents or exploratory archive history is not captured. Keep pooled estimates uncorrected to preserve entropy bias direction. Per index also Bonferroni-protect simultaneous one-sided lower score endpoints for every compressed model plus full, and one upper full endpoint (family alpha=.05). Report max(0, simultaneous L_H lower endpoint)/simultaneous U_V upper endpoint ONLY if the simultaneous lower and upper full endpoints are positive. This bounds the fraction of full physical face information; do not divide two lower scores. No joint coverage claim across temperatures or secondary chain-rule analyses.
selection: Cold validation selects exactly one strongest ordinary (minimum physical face conditional CE among conventional codes including affine; exact ties resolve lexicographically). Report all codes, original rsmi separately. Cold superiority of discrete requires simultaneous paired 95% Bonferroni intervals vs EVERY ordinary comparator above zero; report separate historical-rsmi contrast in the same family. Simultaneous contrast intervals prevent claiming a selected coding advantage using an unadjusted cold interval. A paired difference is a predictive advantage, not proof of an information ordering or a neural-network advantage.
primary_prediction: At index 4 (beta=1.355555555556), with maps and decoders unchanged, the expected physical-face log score of discrete exceeds the cold-selected strongest ordinary comparator by at least 0.001 nat per physical face. This is the only promoted transfer target; always score and publish it, even after a cold null. Support if the two-sided 95% lower limit of the paired packet difference is >=0.001; excluded if the upper limit is <0.001; otherwise unresolved. No switching comparator, fitting a warm marginal, rescoring to choose a different temperature, relabeling the candidate as original RSMI, or fallback prediction. Separate measured contrast vs original rsmi is descriptive.
controls: Indices 8 and 0 are unchanged-transfer descriptive controls, not alternate confirmations. Beta=0 is a physical high-temperature control, not assumed exactly independent under finite-size composition constraints. For the estimator itself, algebraic cold TRAIN controls preserve each (J,V) mass and make the target either one of two equally likely independent patterns, or exactly the emitted label. Verify the compressed-count entropy chain (zero and H(H|J) respectively) and sandwich orientation without random draws.
timeline: Design and code first; cold training and cold validation second. Publish the cold lock, evidence, selected comparator, encoder/decoder files and script SHA before any new transfer extraction or scoring. The confirmatory launch must supply the SHA256 of the previously published cold-lock.json, NOT a hash newly generated from a warm run. Source pins use release metadata only; index 4 has previous analyses and is not pristine independent data. Validation only at transfer; never index 6, a test fold, new configurations, dynamics or MCMC. No thermodynamic extrapolation.
